items.raw_excerpt: Monday September 7th could be a key date for the full enforcement of the EU's biometric border checks with concerns raised that queues at border checks could get longer and slower this month.
items.summary_en: The EU's new biometric border entry system, called EES, is set to start full enforcement on September 7th. Travelers crossing European borders may face longer and slower queues as the system is rolled out. Officials worry that the changes could cause major delays at busy border crossings.
items.summary_ko: EU의 새로운 생체인식 출입국 시스템(EES)이 9월 7일부터 전면 시행될 예정이다. 국경을 넘어가는 여행자들은 시스템 도입으로 대기 시간이 길어질 수 있다. 당국은 주요 국경 검문소에서 큰 혼잡이 발생할 수 있다고 우려하고 있다.
items.title_en: EU biometric border checks could mean longer queues this month
items.title_ko: EU 생체인식 국경검사, 이달 중 대기 줄 더 길어질 수 있어
items.title_original: Could Europe's border queues get longer this month as key EES date passes?

items.raw_excerpt: Open your eyes to this very useful French portmanteau.
items.summary_en: A useful French word of the day has been shared. The word is a portmanteau that means to open something only partway. It can be used in many everyday situations.

items.summary_en: The Local Denmark features a daily Danish word. Today's word is røvsyg, which relates to feeling bored. It is a fun way to learn everyday Danish expressions.
